# monkeytester

> Bugs your tests didn't think to look for. Point it at a URL. It finds the bugs, then proves you fixed them.

Open-source AGPL-3.0 TypeScript engine. Package `@monkeytestai/monkeytester`. CLI `monkeytest`. Node.js 20+. Playwright and your LLM. With an OpenAI key the default model is `gpt-4o-mini`.

npm `latest` is 0.6.1. Pre-release builds publish on the `next` tag. These docs match the `main` branch.

Hosted cloud: https://monkeytest.ai
Source: https://github.com/monkeytestai/monkeytester
